Region: United States. Extracted only commercial lighting, for the 2000-era incumbents (ruling 2026-10-14): 2003 and 2007 installed-base and 2011 typical systems for 8-ft T12 (lighting_fluorescent-t12), 8-ft and 4-ft T8 (lighting_fluorescent-t8), mercury vapour, metal halide and high-pressure sodium high bay (lighting_hid), T5 HO high bay (lighting_fluorescent-high-bay), and 2011 LED high-bay and 4-ft LED substitutes. System efficacy (lm/W), total installed cost and annual maintenance per system put per klm of system lumens (2011 USD), and lamp life in hours. The 2003 installed base is the closest year to 2000 in any held source. No 4-ft T12 table; operating hours not printed. The rest of the report (residential and commercial HVAC, water heating, appliances, projections) is not extracted; the March 2023 edition (eia_2023_002) carries the current equipment.
